prompt:
Generate a finished self-contained index.html and dashboard.png design reference for TicketRush, a flash-sale distributed-systems portfolio dashboard, sober and recruiter-facing, with restrained CSS-only motion. Use frontend-design and the attached dashboard system, with the repository tokens taking precedence. No React, Tailwind, new dependencies, remote fonts or network calls. Never modify the repository or its Angular files: your deliverables belong only in this Open Design project. Read these source inputs from /Users/phuong/Documents/Tech/GitHub/ticketrush/.worktrees/feat-ui-refresh/: docs/design/dashboard/dashboard-running.png (the real current before screenshot), dashboard/src/app/app.html, dashboard/src/styles.css, docs/design/dashboard/verify-reference.cjs, and docs/design/dashboard/index.html (working demo contract to preserve). Do not edit any of those inputs. Current page is a centered dark operations shell: brand/header, Ticket operations heading and subtitle, notice and freshness indicator, equal stock and throughput cards, horizontal buy form, recent-orders table and footer. Improve spacing, typographic hierarchy, density and alignment without a decorative hero, sidebar, gradients or dead empty band at 1440px. Fill the viewport width with a useful operational table; no fake claims or telemetry.

21st catalog patterns already harvested via search/get, not installed: component 34511 Sparkline by appica-dev: compact inline SVG trend alongside a tabular KPI, no chart library. Component 25394 Status by diceui: quiet bordered pill, semantic colour, transform/opacity dot pulse. Component 22174 Card Table by felipemenezes098: card header hierarchy, restrained row dividers and status badges, right-aligned tabular amounts. Adapt these patterns, do not copy their React implementations. Use one token system: --bg #0c111c, --surface #101722, --raised #202936, --fg #eef6ff, --muted #b1bfce, --border #303b49, --accent #0ea5e9, --warning #f5bf63, --danger #ff9a94; local IBM Plex Sans / Segoe UI / Helvetica / sans-serif, ui-monospace for ids, amounts and timestamps, font-variant-numeric tabular-nums. Add named spacing tokens as needed.

Mandatory product decisions: no stock progress bar because capacity is unknown; no price anywhere. Stock and orders/sec inline SVG sparklines represent at most the last 30 successful polls, clearly labelled 'sampled by this page', reset on event change/reload. All data and interactions are illustrative with one concise notice stating 'accepted is not confirmed' exactly once. Event id remains a labelled text input, never a selector. Quantity 1-4 integer. Table shows PENDING, RESERVED, CONFIRMED, FAILED with failureReason PAYMENT_FAILED, and REJECTED as actual statuses. Order id text first 8 chars only with full id in title and accessible name. Null failure reason is muted '-' plus sr-only 'None'. Correct singular '1 order' versus plural '2 orders'. Show UTC timestamps, amount/currency from illustrative orders only (not stock price), no customer or key values. Horizontal scroll on narrow screens, visible focus, >=44px input/button targets, readable contrast.

Four motion rules only: KPI value fade/slide <=200ms only when the value changes, not identical values or first load; polling dot transform/opacity pulse while fresh and static amber while stale; new-row colour highlight only if orderId absent from previous successful poll, never first load, cleared by next successful poll; badge colour transition. No extra motion timers or libraries, use only the existing 2000ms poll and existing buy-response simulation timer. Disable all four under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, both matchMedia exposure (guard for absent browser globals in VM) and CSS media query. Demonstrate changes with labelled illustrative demo data on the existing poll, without making initial reference values unstable before the verifier executes. Track history arrays in memory, no external fetch.

CRITICAL: pass the EXISTING UNMODIFIED node docs/design/dashboard/verify-reference.cjs <your index.html>. Read it and use the existing demo JS as the compatible baseline. It executes the FIRST literal <script> block in a very small VM with only document.getElementById, setTimeout and setInterval. No window, DOM queries, matchMedia, Date or other browser APIs may be required unguarded at initialization. Its element mocks have value, style, classList.add/remove, setAttribute, reportValidity and addEventListener, but not querySelector, toggle, dataset or createElement. Keep enhanced browser-only paths guarded without weakening functionality. All JS must be in one plain <script> block. Required exact data-od-id attributes: stock-zone, throughput-zone, buy-zone, orders-zone. Required IDs: stock-value, rate-value, buy-form, event-id, quantity, buy-button, buy-message, demo-state, freshness-text, table-container, tbody. Heading exactly 'Ticket operations'. CSP includes connect-src 'none'; no fetch(, XMLHttpRequest, customerId, idempotencyKey, Unicode en/em dash anywhere in HTML. No private data shown. Initial rate-value.textContent must be string '3.2' from 32 orders / 10 seconds. On ready state stock-value.textContent must be numeric 248. Only setInterval delay 2000. Buy form submit: preventDefault; pending guard permits one timer only; disable Buy while pending. Maintain top-level accessible lexical variable attempt with attempt.key, event and quantity locked/preserved after simulated first failure. First submit event=test-event quantity=4: one async timer -> button text Retry, preserve fields and attempt.key. Second submit: reuse same attempt.key, one timer -> text Buy, disabled false, buy-message.textContent includes '4 tickets for test-event'. Quantity=5: invalid, no timer. Demo state selector change values stale/loading/empty/error/ready: stale sets freshness-text text containing uppercase STALE; loading/empty/error set table-container.hidden true; ready sets it false and numeric stock 248. Keep that exact contract even if copy elsewhere is refined. Validate using the unchanged verifier before finishing and refine ONLY through your Open Design generation.

Export dashboard.png with Open Design's own renderer using "$OD_NODE_BIN" "$OD_BIN" export index.html --project "$OD_PROJECT_ID" --format image --out dashboard.png . Return project-file absolute paths, export command and gate output. Ensure screenshot captures all four zones at 1440px layout and inspect mobile as well. Do not ask discovery questions: this is a finalized brief. Produce actual files and renderer output, not a plan.
